_comment: 复制安装（技能在 .claude/skills/）的 Claude Code 项目：把 hooks 键合并进项目根 .claude/settings.json（已有 hooks 则按事件追加，不覆盖其他键）。插件安装的层不需要——yzj-flow 插件自带 common/hooks/hooks.json。脚本 fail-open。模板来源：framework/skills/templates/hooks/claude-settings-hooks.json

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills/dev-session/scripts/restore_context.py"; done; echo "yzj hook: 未找到可运行的 python，跳过压缩恢复注入" >&2; exit 0

for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills/git-commit/scripts/commit_guard.py" pretooluse; done; echo "yzj hook: 未找到可运行的 python，跳过 git commit 检查" >&2; exit 0
